title: Shout It
problem: Read one line of text. Print it in capital letters with an exclamation mark added at the end. For example, hello there gives HELLO THERE!
starter_code:
# Read one line of text.
# Print it in capital letters, followed by an exclamation mark.

# Write your code here

hints.1: Python can change the case of a whole piece of text in one step, and two pieces of text can be joined with a plus sign.
hints.2: Text has a method that gives back the capital-letter version of it. Add the exclamation mark to the end with +, then print the result.

failure_explanation: Change every letter to a capital and leave spaces, digits and punctuation alone, then add the exclamation mark once, at the very end. Print one line only, and do not add a space before the exclamation mark.
